nginx

The admin pages of teambox answer on its own network only. Tunnel traffic reaches nginx from 127.0.0.1, and the lanOnly guard denies loopback on purpose, so nobody on the internet reaches the admin UI. Use /nextcloud from outside, or open http://teambox.local/ from home.

res.html:
acme-gwLosOS edge gateway

Gateway for this network

Uplink to the official edge: up · boxes are public under acme.losos.cfd
Enrolled boxes (open enrolment, trust on first use)
teambox, annabox, peterbox, evabox
Mesh control plane: rke2 server, 2 node(s): teambox, annabox

The gateway is not official: boxes behind it can share storage and compute, but trade on the market only through an official edge.
